svg.text: Gauge = overview (pace), filled square = context (how full), coin = cost. Context selected. Terminal cannot draw SVG: it keeps a text glyph (one of A to G, or the current set). Emoji: colour in the app; in the terminal each is 2 cells wide and its look depends on the font.
